name: ⚽ Roxball [BETA 0.35v] ⏳
desc:
🏆 Welcome to RoxBall! 🏆

⚽ Fast-paced 3D football inspired by classic online arcade titles!
🎮 Compete on dynamic fields, master the ball, and score epic goals.
🎯 Customize your player and challenge friends in frantic multiplayer matches.
🔥 Speed, strategy, and endless fun—ready to be the best?

- The game is in BETA, so it’s not finished yet. Minor issues may occur; we ship weekly updates to improve the game!
- XP, Coins, and Stats are saved only when there are 4+ players on the server.
- Available on PC, mobile devices, and consoles (XBOX).

Controls
🖥️💻 PC: Space key
📱 Mobile: Kick button
🎮 Console: RT button

Tags: Football, Team Sports, Soccer, Haxball, Roxball
